## System Header Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" label
- **Center**: "Files" label
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 23:55"
  - System notification bell icon
  - System status icons (network, sound, power)

## Desktop Environment
- **Background**: Abstract geometric wallpaper with gradient from deep purple to red-orange
- **Desktop Icons**:
  - Bottom right corner:
    - PowerPoint file icon labeled "CPD_Background_Inv..."
    - Folder icon labeled "Home"

## File Manager Window
- **Window Title**: "Home"
- **Window Controls** (top-right):
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button (X)

## File Manager Toolbar
- **Navigation Buttons** (left side):
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
- **Location Bar**:
  - Home icon
  - "Home" text
- **Action Buttons** (center):
  - Three-dot menu button
  - Search icon
- **View Options** (right side):
  - View mode dropdown (currently showing grid view icon)
  - View mode toggle button
  - Minimize button
  - Maximize button
  - Close button

## Sidebar Navigation
- **Navigation Items**:
  - Recent
  - Starred
  - Home (selected, highlighted)
  - Desktop

## Sort Dropdown Menu
- **Menu Title**: "Sort"
- **Menu Options**:
  - Search icon
  - "50%" (zoom level)
  - Search icon
  - A-Z (selected)
  - Z-A
  - Last Modified
  - First Modified
  - Size (selected, with orange dot)
  - Type
  - Reload

## Desktop Dock
- **Application Icons** (left side, top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Files (File Manager)

  - Help (question mark)
